findings.title: Deposit is within the amount cap
findings.detail: This amount check does not verify deposit protection or authenticity. Annual rent GBP 15600; cap = 15600 / 52 * 5 (GBP 1500.00 rounded down to pennies); requested GBP 1500. Importance: 85/100. Conditional: Confirm that the rented property is in England. Confirm this is an ordinary private tenancy, not an excluded arrangement. Confirm that rent and deposit cover the same whole tenancy. Sources: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/tenant-fees-act-2019-guidance-for-tenants

findings.title: Mandatory non-refundable administration fee of GBP 300
findings.detail: Rider clause 12 requires the tenant to pay a non-refundable administration fee of GBP 300 for preparing the tenancy agreement, in addition to rent and deposit. Under the supplied fees rule, mandatory administration fees are a concern. The rider expressly overrides the earlier statement that no administration fee is payable. Importance: 80/100. Conditional: Confirm that the rented property is in England. Confirm this is an ordinary private tenancy, not an excluded arrangement. Jurisdiction and tenancy type are unknown, so whether the fee ban applies is not confirmed. It is unclear whether the rider is part of the signed agreement. Sources: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/tenant-fees-act-2019-guidance-for-tenants
